seeds: splitmix64 seed 11 for the random shape; structured shapes are seed-free (canonical enumeration)
claim_boundary_non_claims: toy rungs (20 and 24 bits), not secp256k1
no key recovery, no asymptotic sub-rho claim
no claim that any base shape raises the expected yield: the counting identity proves the opposite
hit-rate is exact for one base per cell, not a sample mean

drafts.base_id_basis: recipe string (p, curve, shape, m, N, enumeration rule); NOT a hash of the materialised dlog list
drafts.eta_or_coverage_policy: exhaustive: every m-multiset of the base enumerated, r(R) accumulated over the whole group; coverage = |E| (no sampling)

pr_decomposition_or_hit_rate_with_ci.note: the value is exact for this base; the interval is the binomial error a T-target estimate of the same quantity would carry, reported so the field is comparable
